what: Enter through the window cut in the middle of the Hero image (bag lid·billboard·window). At the top, on the first wheel (touch) the image scales 5.2x toward the window spot over 1s ease, while the sky panel inside the window blurs 5px over 1s after .3s as it widens to screen size (.6s) and drifts upward for 1.5s. From below, the video panel fills in over 1.5s after .4s and darkens to .8 over 1.4s. The big title pulls out after .5s with -10rem·.7x and vanishes over 1s, the next title enters from 110% below over 1.4s, and the text·button enter from 2rem below over 1.5s in .6s. Scroll is locked for 2s while entering and 1.5s while rewinding back to the top (on rewind the video drops immediately and the title returns after 1.3s over .8s)

options.scale: Image zoom multiplier, default 5.2 (original phone 7.4) — also via --fx-scale
options.origin: Growth center, default 50% 20rem (window position) — also settable via --fx-origin
options.--fx-frame-w / --fx-frame-h: Size of the sky panel in the window, default 45% · 85% (100% once entered)
options.--fx-pan: Position where the sky panel image flows upward on entering, default -100rem (background position · object-position)
options.--fx-drift / --fx-drift-dur: Width the sky panel drifts left and right · one cycle, default 5rem · 30s
options.--fx-mark: Opacity of the decorative mark after entering, default .3
options.[data-fx-part=scene]: Growing image (illustration with a window cut-out)
options.[data-fx-part=sky] > [data-fx-part=frame: Sky panel seen through the window (background image or img·video)
options.[data-fx-part=video]: Video panel rising from below (the inner video darkens)
options.[data-fx-part=head] · [data-fx-part=next: Title that rises after entering (text inside an overflow-hidden line) · text, buttons and decoration

note: The lock is the panel’s entrance motion itself, so on touch too the page freezes for 2s. Use it on one Hero screen only. Rewind happens when the scroll reaches the very top (0). With reduced motion it switches instantly. Chain follow-ups onto the fx:dive event (detail.in), such as changing the header line color.
